name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, GPS/compass refresh fixes, map/cache status, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, SD message journal support, USB SD-card mass storage, SD prepare/reset tools, screen correction tools, and a public on-device health panel.

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, ringtone storage, logs, and USB mass storage; not required to boot.

build.status: WSL build completed successfully. Firmware contains the USB SD-card mass-storage callbacks, TDECK SD CARD USB product string, TDECKSDCARD volume-label writer, SD prepare/reset UI, and corrected I2S RTTTL ringtone playback.

publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
